name: What are the common signs that my door handle needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my door handle needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating a door handle replacement is needed include difficulty turning the handle, a loose or wobbly handle, visible damage like cracks or corrosion, or if the latch mechanism is no longer engaging properly. Sometimes, security concerns due to wear or a desire to upgrade the aesthetics or functionality of a door also prompt replacement. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage to the door and maintain security.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include a loose or wobbly handle, difficulty turning, visible damage, or a malfunctioning latch. Replacement also addresses security concerns or aesthetic upgrades.
